safeBrowsing.title: Kid-Safe Browsing & Web Filter
safeBrowsing.subtitle: Protected online portal curated for students across Bangladesh, safeguarding against adult content and cyber threats.
safeBrowsing.searchPlaceholder: Search safe educational topics (e.g., Mathematics, Science, History of Bangladesh)...
safeBrowsing.testerInputPlaceholder: Enter a phrase or website link to test safety status...
safeBrowsing.rule1: Never share your full name, school uniform photos, or phone numbers online.
safeBrowsing.rule2: Tell a trusted elder immediately if someone online makes you feel uncomfortable.
safeBrowsing.rule3: Only visit verified educational websites approved by your teachers and parents.

about.title: Standing for Every Child Across Bangladesh
about.story: Children throughout Bangladesh—from bustling city neighborhoods to rural village schools, haor wetlands, hill tracts, and river islands—face challenges including school dropouts, hazardous labor, and online risks. Child Voice unites nationwide grassroots youth defense with digital safeguarding tools.
